component.title: ConditionalField
component.purpose: A store-driven boundary that keeps dependent fields, values, and recovery behavior coherent.

states.description: A dependent field is present when its expression is true.
Dependent values return to defaults when their parent condition disappears.

claims.statement: Visibility is derived from the form store rather than duplicated local state or consumer conditional markup.
Reset mode makes the hidden-value policy explicit instead of silently submitting stale dependent data.
The field boundary preserves its parent form rhythm when the dependency changes.
